chapter: Medicine show, hoboing and train songs
title: Trying to recall the water-tank hobo song
summary: Allen asks for the song about sitting by the water tank waiting for a train; Nash cannot remember the words and Allen suggests trying again next time.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Well how does that thing about sitting by the water tank go? Do you remember any of that?
Well I'm trying to think of it now. Sitting by the water tank.
Well take your time and do it right.

Waiting for a tram. I haven't got a penny. I can't remember some of the guys singing. Sitting there waiting for a tram. Sitting at the water tank waiting for a tram. I haven't got a penny. The tickets are in the van. Walk up to the basement. For a game of talk. The basement said. Boy I see that you don't walk. Some kind of way them guys are singing that. I really can't remember that. I wouldn't like to do that number. But I just can't get. I can't remember the words. I used to know it all too. But I really had forgotten the words.
Well it'll come back to you next time we do this.
Yeah maybe so. I'll think of it.
